title: 第20章 帮手来啦
content_zh:
忽听铛的一声大响，火花四溅，闵嘉庚与厉宏明双刀相交。一响之后，接着响之不已。原来厉宏明越转越快，越砍越凌厉。闵嘉庚毕竟是年幼识浅，不明他刀法路数，到后来闪避不及，只得举刀还格。双刀既交，厉宏明心中暗喜：“这小子武功不坏，力气究小，再砍几刀，他武器非脱手不可。”当下不住急砍猛斫，闵嘉庚只得硬接，五六刀过后，手臂震得渐感酸麻。温宏伟的紫金刀颇为沉重，闵嘉庚力小，使动时本已不大顺手，这时更感吃力。

    厉宏明身材魁梧，闵嘉庚的头还及不到他头颈，一个居高临下，一个仰头接招，强弱之势更加悬殊。闵嘉庚眼见不敌，突然灵机一动，将他一刀架开，跳出圈子，叫了声：“且慢！”厉宏明跟他本无仇怨，他也没得罪了自己或吴总，见他小小年纪，居然能接下自己数十招，动了爱才之念，说道：“好吧，你认输便是，就饶你一命。”

    闵嘉庚笑着说：“谁认输了？你不过胜在生得牛高马大，身材上占了便宜，那又算什么本事？你等一下。”说着搬过一张板凳，往大厅中心一放，纵身上凳，叫道：“咱们再来比过。”厉宏明又好气又好笑，问道：“那算什么？”闵嘉庚说：“咱们话说明在先，你可不许踢动我板凳，否则就算你输了。”厉宏明“呸”了声说：“天下哪有这般比武法子？”闵嘉庚笑着说：“我人未长足，自没你高。你若不愿，五年后等我长得跟你一般高了，再来决个胜败。”

    闵嘉庚平时听王辉谈论他父亲的威风，只道学得父亲遗书上的武功后，也可如父亲一般所向无敌，岂知一上手就给温老太扣住脉门，结结实实挨了一顿好打。那还可说自己一时不防，这时跟厉宏明一动手，才知自己虽然刀法大胜于他，功力却跟他差得太远，交代了这几句话，就想趁机脱身。

    哪知厉宏明一来丢不起这个脸，二来自恃必胜，骂道：“小猴崽子，不踢你这凳子又怎么了？怕老子劈不死你么？”说着挥刀向他腰间削去。

    闵嘉庚横刀封挡，二人又交上了手，此时闵嘉庚却已高过了对方，他在板凳上奔左蹿右，抡刀而战。那板凳有五尺来长，厉宏明若再绕着转动，转的圈子太大，跟他二十多年来所练的圈子大小不同，这是熟练了的功夫，临时改变不来，当下改使一套刀中夹掌、掌中夹刀的武功，要以刚猛的刀风掌力，将对方震下板凳来。

    闵嘉庚知他心意，不停纵跃蹿避，不再硬接。厉宏明虽专修万澜武功，但父亲的好多绝技都没能学精，只是专精八卦刀和八卦掌，好在这两种武功也甚繁复，单是刀法，就有大架、小架、内架、外架诸项变形。他刀法立变，左挥右削，专砍敌手中盘。刀法砍的是对方中盘，但闵嘉庚站在凳上，实则是砍他腿脚。闵嘉庚跃起躲闪。厉宏明削得数刀，见闵嘉庚又再跃起，不待他落下，跟着挥刀贴凳横削，收刀时自左向右拖转，闵嘉庚如落脚踏上板凳，一足非给削断不可，要避过这两削，便只有离凳落地。

    闵嘉庚见势在两难，突然伸脚尖在板凳左端用力一点，借势上跃，那板凳蓦地竖立。这下真出其不意，砰的一声，板凳翻上来的右端，正好撞中厉宏明下巴，势道可还着实不轻。闵嘉庚却已站在竖起的板凳顶端，居高临下，抡刀砍下来。这下变故甚是滑稽，旁观众人忍不住失笑。

    厉宏明大怒，挥刀砍了几招，只因闵嘉庚在高处，自己大处劣势，也顾不得曾答应不动他的板凳，左腿飞出，踢翻板凳，跟着一刀“上步劈山”向闵嘉庚胸口剁去。闵嘉庚人未落地，横刀挡架，借着他一剁之势，蹿出半丈，一个俯身，左手举起板凳，当作一条长形盾牌，以板凳挡架敌刀，右手的紫金刀却一刀刀递出去。

    厉宏生见兄弟久战不下，早已皱起了眉头，旁观众人中魏从善、李云、杲瑜亮、岳胜等均是江湖好手，见战局变幻，闵嘉庚早已落败，厉宏明却始终拾夺他不下，都暗暗称奇。

    此时闵嘉庚左凳右刀，大占便宜。那板凳是红木所造，甚为坚硬，被厉宏明连砍几刀，却砍之不断。闵嘉庚躲在凳后，反而不住抢攻。厉宏明骂道：“小猴崽子，叫你知道厉害！”猛地里一招“上歪门”，挥刀斜砍，噔的一声，一刀砍在板凳正中，岂知这下使力太强，刀刃深入凳内，回手一拔竟拔不出来。他正要加力回夺，突见紫光闪动，对手的刀尖已刺向自己小腹。这招犹如流水行云，来得好快，厉宏明一惊，只得撒手放刀。他明明已占上风，却给这小孩胡混夺去武器，焉肯甘服？当即空手进击，这位刀法名家竟要以一双肉掌挽回脸面。

    只见他点打戳拿，劈击压撞，双掌在刀缝中抢攻而前，威势竟不下于使刀之时。闵嘉庚力弱，挺着一条笨重的板凳，如何能与他轻捷的空手相敌？眨眼间连遇险招，啪的一响，肩头被他一掌击中，险些跌倒。旁观众人一起惊呼。

    闵嘉庚忍住疼痛，左手将板凳一送一放，随即抓住凳面上的单刀刀柄，右足在凳上猛踢一腿，板凳离刀，向厉宏明撞去。厉宏明见他拼斗不依常法，一味胡混，大有相辱之意，心中越怒，双掌疾向板凳劈去。这板凳先前已受刀砍，再加掌力一震，喀喇一响，顿时断为两截。闵嘉庚却已双刀在手，着地卷来。

    厉宏明空手对双刀，丝毫不惧，右手擒拿，左手摆钩，突然闵嘉庚惊叫一声，左手刀已被他夹手夺去。厉宏明将钢刀往地下摔落，仍是空手对刀。他在掌法上浸淫二十余年，使将出来果然凌厉已极。温文新在旁瞧得又沮丧又欢喜，沮丧的是自己从小苦练，只道已窥堂奥，但与这位师叔相较，不知何年何月方能练到他这般功夫，欢喜的是本门武功如此神妙，只要不断修习，前途自不可限量。

    猛听厉宏明暴喝一声：“去！”闵嘉庚紫金刀脱手飞出，忙向后跃开。

    厉宏明双掌一并，排山倒海般击过来。闵嘉庚眼见抵挡不住，情急智生，忽地指着他哈哈大笑。厉宏明给他笑得莫名其妙，收掌不发，愣了一愣，喝问：“小子，你笑什么？”闵嘉庚笑着说：“我的帮手过来啦，不再怕你们这许多大人合力欺侮我。”厉宏明一愕，自忖：“我是江湖上的成名人物，跟这小鬼头一般见识，到底该是不该？”闵嘉庚笑着说：“我这就接我帮手去，你们都等着，可别怕了逃走。”趁着厉宏明迟疑未定，急步向厅门走出，便想趁机溜开。温老太拾起紫金刀，纵上拦住，喝道：“小杂种，想逃么？”她知这小孩武功胜己，不敢逼得太近。

    就在此时，忽听远处马蹄声响，急驰而来。静夜之中，蹄声清晰异常，本来快马狂奔，蹄声繁密，也是常事，但说也奇怪，这匹马落蹄之声犹如急雨，比两匹马同时奔跑的蹄声还更紧密。厅上诸人多半是江湖上的大行家，钢刀快马，原是家常便饭，但听蹄声奇特，不禁脸上均现诧异之色。霎时间，那马已奔到了堡前，但听佣工呼叱声、门推开声、佣工翻跌声、武器落地声接着响起。众人愕然相顾之际，厅口已多了一人。

    蹄声初起是在三数里外，但顷刻间，此人已闯进堡来，现身厅口，其迅雷不及掩耳的神速，委实罕见罕闻。群豪耸动之下，目光一起注视在来人身上。

    只见那人五十岁左右年纪，穿一件腰身宽大的外套，上唇微髭，头发已现花白，中等身材，略见肥胖，笑吟吟的面目慈祥，右手携着个十二三岁的女孩。瞧他模样，就似是个乡下财商，随口就要拱一拱手，说出“恭喜发财”的话来，虽略觉俗气，却神态可亲，与进堡时那股剽悍凌厉的势道全不相符。

    闵嘉庚初时哈哈大笑，原为暂止厉宏明的凌厉进攻，忽听远处马蹄声，便胡乱说道有帮手到来，信口开河，只盼众人一个不提防，就此溜走，岂知事有凑巧，刚好有人赶进堡来。他趁着众人群相注视那胖子之际，绕到各人背后，慢慢走向厅门。
content_en:
Suddenly there was a loud clang sound, sparks flew everywhere, and Min Jiageng and Li Hongming's swords intersected. After one ring, there were more ringings. It turned out that Li Hongming turned faster and faster, and slashed harder and harder. After all, Min Jiageng was young and inexperienced, so he didn't know the skills of his sword skills. In the end, he couldn't dodge, so he had to raise his sword to fight back. As the two swords crossed, Li Hongming secretly rejoiced: "This guy's martial arts are not bad, but his strength is small. If he cuts a few more times, his weapon will have to be released." He couldn't help but cut sharply, and Min Jiageng had to take it hard. After five or six cuts, his arm gradually became sore and numb. Wen Hongwei's Purple Gold Sword was quite heavy, and Min Jiageng's strength was weak, so it was already difficult to use it smoothly, and it became even more difficult now.

    Li Hongming was tall and tall, and Min Jiageng's head could not reach his neck. One was condescending, while the other raised his head to receive the attack. The disparity between strength and weakness was even greater. Seeing that he was defeated, Min Jiageng suddenly had an idea and cut him away with a knife, jumped out of the circle and shouted: "Wait a minute!" Li Hongming had no grudge against him at all, and he had not offended himself or Mr. Wu. Seeing that he could take dozens of his moves at a young age, he was moved by his talent and said, "Okay, if you admit defeat, I will spare your life."

    Min Jiageng said with a smile: "Who gave up? You are only better because you were born tall and tall, and you took advantage of your figure, so what's your ability? Wait a minute." Then he moved a bench, put it in the center of the hall, jumped up on the bench, and shouted: "Let's compete again." Li Hongming was angry and funny, and asked: "What's that?" Min Jiageng said: "Let's explain it first. You are not allowed to kick my bench, otherwise you will lose." Li Hongming said "bah" and said: "How can there be such a way to compete in martial arts in the world?" Min Jiageng said with a smile: "I have not grown up, and I am not as tall as you. If you don't want to, wait until I am as tall as you in five years, and then we can decide the outcome."

    Min Jiageng usually listened to Wang Hui talking about his father's majesty. He only thought that after learning the martial arts written in his father's suicide note, he could be as invincible as his father. Little did he know that as soon as he got started, Mrs. Wen would grab her pulse and receive a good beating. It can be said that I was unprepared for a moment. When I started fighting with Li Hongming, I realized that although my sword skills were much better than his, my skill was far behind him. After saying these few words, I wanted to take the opportunity to escape.

    Unexpectedly, Li Hongming couldn't afford to lose face. Secondly, he was confident that he would win. He cursed: "Little monkey, what's going to happen if I don't kick your stool? Are you afraid that I can't kill you?" He said and slashed at his waist with a knife.

    Min Jiageng blocked the opponent with his sword, and the two fought again. At this time, Min Jiageng was already higher than his opponent. He ran around on the bench, swinging his knife and fighting. The bench was about five feet long. If Li Hongming continued to turn around, the circle would be too big and different from the circles he had practiced for more than 20 years. This was a skill he had mastered and could not be changed at the moment. He now used a set of martial arts of holding a knife in the palm and a knife in the palm. He wanted to use the strong force of the sword wind to knock the opponent off the bench.

    Min Jiageng knew what he was thinking, so he kept leaping and evading, and no longer forced a direct attack. Although Li Hongming specializes in Wanlan martial arts, he has not mastered many of his father's unique skills. He only specializes in Bagua Dao and Baguazhang. Fortunately, these two martial arts are also very complicated. The sword technique alone has many modifications such as large frame, small frame, inner frame, and outer frame. His swordsmanship changes immediately, swinging left and right, specializing in cutting the opponent's middle plate. The sword technique was intended to cut the opponent's middle plate, but with Min Jiageng standing on the bench, he was actually cutting his legs and feet. Min Jiageng jumped up to dodge. Li Hongming had cut several times, and saw Min Jiageng jumping up again. Without waiting for him to fall, he swung the knife against the bench and cut horizontally. When he retracted the knife, he dragged it from left to right. As if Min Jiageng had landed on the bench, one of his feet had to be cut off. To avoid these cuts, he had to leave the bench and fall to the ground.

    Seeing that he was in a dilemma, Min Jiageng suddenly stretched out his toes and pressed a little harder on the left end of the bench, taking advantage of the situation to jump up. The bench suddenly stood upright. This time it was really unexpected. With a bang, the right end of the bench turned up and hit Li Hongming's chin. The force was quite strong. Min Jiageng was already standing on the top of the erected bench, looking down from a high position and slashing it with his knife. This turn of events was so funny that the onlookers couldn't help laughing.

    Li Hongming was furious and swung his sword several times. Because Min Jiageng was at a high place, he was at a disadvantage. He didn't care about the bench that he had promised not to move. His left leg flew out, kicked the bench over, and then slashed toward Min Jiageng's chest with a "step up and split the mountain" knife. Before Min Jiageng landed, he blocked the enemy's sword with his horizontal sword. With his chop, he jumped half a foot forward, leaned down, and raised the bench with his left hand as a long shield. He used the bench to block the enemy's sword, while the purple gold sword in his right hand was thrust forward.

    Li Hongsheng had already frowned when he saw that his brother had been unable to win for a long time. Among the spectators, Wei Congshan, Li Yun, Gao Yuliang, Yue Sheng, etc. were all good players. Seeing the changing situation of the battle, Min Jiageng had already been defeated, but Li Hongming still couldn't beat him, and they were all secretly surprised.

    At this time, Min Jiageng was taking advantage of him. The bench was made of mahogany and was very hard. Li Hongming slashed at it several times, but kept cutting. Min Jiageng hid behind the bench but kept attacking. Li Hongming scolded: "Little monkey boy, I want you to know how powerful you are!" He suddenly made a move "up to the crooked door" and slashed diagonally with the knife. With a thud, the knife hit the middle of the bench. Unexpectedly, the force used was too strong and the blade went deep into the bench. When he pulled back, he couldn't pull it out. Just as he was about to use more force to regain his strength, he suddenly saw a flash of purple light, and the tip of his opponent's knife had pierced his lower abdomen. This move was like flowing water flowing through the clouds, it came so fast that Li Hongming was startled and had no choice but to let go and release the knife. He clearly had the upper hand, but he was ruthlessly taking away his weapon from this child. How could he be willing to accept it? He immediately attacked with bare hands, but this master of swordsmanship actually tried to save his face with a pair of fleshy palms.

    He was seen poking, poking, chopping and bumping, and rushing forward with both palms in the gap between the swords. His power was no less than when he used the swords. Min Jiageng was weak and was holding up a heavy bench. How could he compete with his nimble bare hands? In the blink of an eye, he made a series of dangerous moves, and with a snap, his shoulder was hit by his palm, and he almost fell down. The onlookers exclaimed together.

    Min Jiageng resisted the pain and moved the bench up and down with his left hand. Then he grabbed the handle of the single knife on the bench and kicked the bench with his right foot. The bench left the knife and hit Li Hongming. When Li Hongming saw that he was not fighting according to the rules and was just messing around, with the intention of humiliating each other, he became angrier and struck at the bench with both palms. The bench had been slashed by a knife before, and with a strong shock from the palm, it suddenly broke into two pieces with a click. Min Jiageng already had two swords in his hands and rolled them up on the ground.

    Li Hongming faced the two swords with his bare hands without any fear. He grabbed them with his right hand and hooked with his left hand. Suddenly Min Jiageng screamed and the sword in his left hand had been snatched away by him. Li Hongming dropped the steel knife to the ground and still held it with his bare hands. He has been immersed in the palm technique for more than 20 years, making the generals extremely powerful. Wen Wenxin looked on with a mix of frustration and joy. What was frustrating was that he had practiced hard since he was a child and had only seen the secrets. But compared with this uncle, he didn't know how long it took him to develop such skills. What he was happy about was that our martial arts was so amazing. As long as he kept practicing, his future was limitless.

    Suddenly, he heard Li Hongming yell: "Go!" Min Jiageng's purple-gold sword flew out of his hand and he jumped back.

    Li Hongming combined his palms and struck like an overwhelming force. Seeing that he couldn't resist, Min Jiageng suddenly pointed at him and laughed. Li Hongming laughed incomprehensibly at him. He held his palms without moving. He was stunned for a moment and asked, "Boy, what are you laughing at?" Min Jiageng said with a smile, "My helper is here. I am no longer afraid that many adults like you will work together to bully me." Li Hongming was stunned and thought to himself: "I am Jiang Should a famous person on the lake have the same knowledge as this little devil?" Min Jiageng said with a smile: "I will pick up my helper. You all wait, don't be afraid and run away." Taking advantage of Li Hongming's hesitation, he hurriedly walked out of the hall door, trying to take the opportunity to slip away. Old Mrs. Wen picked up the purple gold knife, stepped forward to stop him, and shouted, "You little bastard, do you want to escape?" She knew that this kid was better than her in martial arts, so she didn't dare to get too close.

    At this moment, I suddenly heard the sound of horse hooves in the distance, galloping towards me. In the quiet night, the sound of hoofbeats was extremely clear. It was normal for a fast horse to run wildly, and the sound of hoofbeats was dense. But strangely enough, the sound of this horse's hoofbeats was like rushing rain, and it was even closer than the sound of two horses running at the same time. Most of the people in the hall were big experts in the martial arts world, and it was common for them to use steel swords and fast horses, but when they heard the strange sound of hoofbeats, they couldn't help but have a look of surprise on their faces. In an instant, the horse had already rushed to the front of the fort, but the sound of servants shouting, the sound of the door being pushed open, the sound of servants falling, and the sound of weapons falling to the ground were heard. When everyone looked at each other in astonishment, there was one more person in the hall.

    The first sound of hoofbeats was three miles away, but in an instant, this person had broken into the castle and appeared at the entrance of the hall. His speed was as fast as lightning, which was really rare to hear. The group of heroes were in a state of excitement, all looking at the person coming.

    I saw that the man was about fifty years old, wearing a coat with a wide waist, a slight mustache on his upper lip, and his hair was already graying. He was of medium height, slightly obese, with a kind smile and a kind face. He was holding a girl of twelve or thirteen years old in his right hand. Looking at him, he looked like a country businessman. He would cup his hand casually and say "Congratulations on getting rich". Although it seemed a little tacky, his demeanor was amiable, which was completely inconsistent with the fierce and fierce demeanor when he entered the castle.

    Min Jiageng laughed loudly at first. He wanted to temporarily stop Li Hongming's fierce attack, but suddenly he heard the sound of horse hooves in the distance, so he said casually that helpers were coming, and he just hoped that everyone would not be wary and just slipped away. Who knew that it was a coincidence that someone just rushed into the fort. While everyone was watching the fat man, he walked around behind everyone and slowly walked towards the hall door.
